9957-the-personal-touch.title: The Personal Touch
9957-the-personal-touch.creator: Unknown
9957-the-personal-touch.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. If Jesus Himself went seeking the lost, if Paul the Apostle was in agony because his kinsmen, according to the flesh, knew not Christ, why should we not consider it worth while to go out after the lost until they are found?

arxiv-1412-4566.description: Abstract Using 482 pb -1 of data taken at s = 4.009 \sqrt{s}=4.009 GeV, we measure the branching fractions of the decays of D ∗ 0 D^{*0} into D 0 ​ π 0 D^{0}\pi^{0} and D 0 ​ γ D^{0}\gamma to be ℬ ⁡ ( D ∗ 0 → D 0 ​ π 0 ) = ( 65.5 ± 0.

arxiv-2108-02093.title: Free Lunch for Co-Saliency Detection: Context Adjustment
arxiv-2108-02093.creator: Lingdong Kong, Prakhar Ganesh, Tan Wang, Junhao Liu, Le Zhang, Yao Chen
arxiv-2108-02093.description: Abstract We unveil a long-standing problem in the prevailing co-saliency detection systems: there is indeed inconsistency between training and testing. Constructing a high-quality co-saliency detection dataset involves time-consuming and labor-intensive pixel-level labeling, which has forced most recent works to rely instead on semantic segmentation or saliency detection datasets for training.

arxiv-2207-05360.title: Entanglement dynamics and ergodicity breaking in a quantum cellular automaton
arxiv-2207-05360.creator: Kevissen Sellapillay, Alberto D. Verga, Giuseppe Di Molfetta
arxiv-2207-05360.description: Abstract Ergodicity breaking is observed in the blockade regime of Rydberg atoms arrays, in the form of low entanglement eigenstates known as scars, which fail to thermalize. The signature of these states persists in periodically driven systems, where they coexist with an extensive number of chaotic states.

arxiv-2207-11123.title: Adaptive Graph-Based Feature Normalization for Facial Expression Recognition
arxiv-2207-11123.creator: Yangtao Du, Qingqing Wang*, Yujie Xiong
arxiv-2207-11123.description: Abstract Facial Expression Recognition (FER) suffers from data uncertainties caused by ambiguous facial images and annotators’ subjectiveness, resulting in excursive semantic and feature covariate shifting problem. Existing works usually correct mislabeled data by estimating noise distribution, or guide network training with knowledge learned from clean data, neglecting the associative relations of expressions.

arxiv-2309-02858.title: Generalised Mutual Information: a Framework for Discriminative Clustering
arxiv-2309-02858.creator: Louis Ohl, Pierre-Alexandre Mattei, Charles Bouveyron, Warith Harchaoui, Mickaël Leclercq, Arnaud Droit, Frédéric Precioso
arxiv-2309-02858.description: Abstract In the last decade, recent successes in deep clustering majorly involved the Mutual Information (MI) as an unsupervised objective for training neural networks with increasing regularisations. While the quality of the regularisations have been largely discussed for improvements, little attention has been dedicated to the relevance of MI as a clustering objective.

arxiv-2309-09932.title: W m W_{m} -algebras and fractional powers of difference operators Thanks: The author gratefully acknowledge support through research funding from the College of Letters & Science at UW-Madison
arxiv-2309-09932.creator: Gloria Marí Beffa
arxiv-2309-09932.description: Abstract . In this paper we describe a Poisson pencil associated to the lattice W m W_{m} -algebras defined in [ 7 ] , and we prove that the Poisson pencil is equal to the one defined in [ 10 ] and [ 3 ] using a type of discrete Drinfel’d-Sokolov reduction.

arxiv-2309-12873.title: Sidorenko Hypergraphs and Random Turán Numbers
arxiv-2309-12873.creator: Jiaxi Nie, Sam Spiro
arxiv-2309-12873.description: Abstract Let ex ⁡ ( G n , p r , F ) \mathrm{ex}(G_{n,p}^{r},F) denote the maximum number of edges in an F F -free subgraph of the random r r -uniform hypergraph G n , p r G_{n,p}^{r} .

arxiv-2407-07364.title: Real-time system optimal traffic routing under uncertainties – Can physics models boost reinforcement learning?
arxiv-2407-07364.creator: Zemian Ke, Qiling Zou, Jiachao Liu, Sean Qian
arxiv-2407-07364.description: Abstract System optimal traffic routing can mitigate congestion by assigning routes for a portion of vehicles so that the total travel time of all vehicles in the transportation system can be reduced. However, achieving real-time optimal routing poses challenges due to uncertain demands and unknown system dynamics, particularly in expansive transportation networks.

arxiv-2412-06088.title: A4-Unet: Deformable Multi-Scale Attention Network for Brain Tumor Segmentation † These authors contributed equally to this work. * Corresponding author.
arxiv-2412-06088.creator: Ruoxin Wang †, Tianyi Tang †, Haiming Du, Yuxuan Cheng, Yu Wang, Lingjie Yang, Xiaohui Duan, Yunfang Yu, Yu Zhou, Donglong Chen *
arxiv-2412-06088.description: Abstract Brain tumor segmentation models have aided diagnosis in recent years. However, they face MRI complexity and variability challenges, including irregular shapes and unclear boundaries, leading to noise, misclassification, and incomplete segmentation, thereby limiting accuracy. To address these issues, we adhere to an outstanding Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) design paradigm and propose a novel network named A4-Unet .

arxiv-2502-15600.title: Robust Bias Detection in MLMs and its Application to Human Trait Ratings
arxiv-2502-15600.creator: Ingroj Shrestha, Louis Tay, Padmini Srinivasan
arxiv-2502-15600.description: Abstract There has been significant prior work using templates to study bias against demographic attributes in MLMs. However, these have limitations: they overlook random variability of templates and target concepts analyzed, assume equality amongst templates, and overlook bias quantification. Addressing these, we propose a systematic statistical approach 1 1 1 Our code and data are available at https://github.

arxiv-2511-12740.title: Deep Imbalanced Multi-Target Regression: 3D Point Cloud Voxel Content Estimation in Simulated Forests
arxiv-2511-12740.creator: Amirhossein Hassanzadeh, Bartosz Krawczyk, Michael Saunders, Rob Wible, Keith Krause, Dimah Dera, Jan van Aardt
arxiv-2511-12740.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Amirhossein Hassanzadeh, Bartosz Krawczyk, Michael Saunders, Rob Wible, Keith Krause, Dimah Dera, Jan van Aardt. Voxelization is an effective approach to reduce the computational cost of processing Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) data, yet it results in a loss of fine-scale structural information. This study explores whether low-level voxel content information, specifically target occupancy percentage within a voxel, can be inferred from high-level voxelized LiDAR point cloud data collected from Digital Imaging and remote Sensing Image Generation (DIRSIG) software.

arxiv-2602-23893.title: AoE: Always-on Egocentric Human Video Collection for Embodied AI
arxiv-2602-23893.creator: Bowen Yang ∗1 , Zishuo Li ∗1 , Yang Sun ∗1 , Changtao Miao ∗†1 , Yifan Yang 2 , Man Luo 1 , Xiaotong Yan 1 , Feng Jiang 1 , Jinchuan Shi 3 , Yankai Fu 4 , Ning Chen 4 , Junkai Zhao 5 , Pengwei Wang 5 , Guocai Yao 5 , Shanghang Zhang 4,5 , Hao Chen 3 , Zhe Li 1 , Kai Zhu ‡1 1 Ant Digital Technologies
arxiv-2602-23893.description: Abstract Embodied foundation models require large-scale, high-quality real-world interaction data for pre-training and scaling. However, existing data collection methods suffer from high infrastructure costs, complex hardware dependencies, and limited interaction scope, making scalable expansion challenging. In fact, humans themselves are ideal physically embodied agents.

europmc-pmc3971609.creator: Segal LN, Alekseyenko AV, Clemente JC, Kulkarni R, Wu B, Gao Z, Chen H, Berger KI, Goldring RM, Rom WN, Blaser MJ, Weiden MD.

Despite evidence that microaspiration is commonly associated with smoking-related lung diseases, the effects of lung microbiome enrichment with upper airway taxa on inflammation has not been

pmc-10672471.title: Oral Health-Related Quality of Life in Adult Patients with Depression or Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
pmc-10672471.creator: Stephan Gemp, Dirk Ziebolz, Rainer Haak, Nicole Mauche, Madlen Prase, Ezgi Dogan-Sander, Frauke Görges, Maria Strauß, Gerhard Schmalz, Irina Esterlis
pmc-10672471.description: The aim of this cross-sectional study was the evaluation of the oral health-related quality of life (OHRQoL) in patients with depression or attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in comparison with a group of mentally healthy individuals. Patients from the Department of Psychiatry and Psychotherapy, University of Leipzig, Germany, were recruited.

pmc-10674565.title: Ethylmethylhydroxypyridine Succinate Is an Inhibitor but Not a Substrate of ABCB1 and SLCO1B1
pmc-10674565.creator: Aleksey V. Shchulkin, Pelageya D. Erokhina, Anna V. Goncharenko, Pavel Yu. Mylnikov, Ivan V. Chernykh, Yulia V. Abalenikhina, Maria S. Kotliarova, Elena N. Yakusheva
pmc-10674565.description: 2-Ethyl-6-methyl-3-hydroxypyridine succinate (EMHPS, Mexidol) is an original antioxidant and an anti-ischemic drug with the possibility of wide applications in the complex therapy of diseases, accompanied by the development of oxidative stress and ischemia; for example, ischemic stroke, chronic cerebral ischemia, and chronic heart failure.

pmc-11356039.title: The Impact of Long COVID on the Quality of Life
pmc-11356039.creator: Angela Cozma, Adela-Viviana Sitar-Tăut, Olga Hilda Orășan, Daniel Corneliu Leucuța, Tinca-Codruța Pocol, Octavia Sălăgean, Camil Crișan, Nicolae-Dan Sporiș, Andrada-Luciana Lazar, Toma-Vlad Mălinescu, Andreea-Maria Ganea, Călin Vasile Vlad, Melinda Horvat, Mihaela Sorina Lupșe, Violeta Briciu, Fumio
pmc-11356039.description: Background and Objectives: The term long COVID refers to patients with a history of confirmed COVID-19 infection, who present symptoms that last for at least 2 months and cannot be explained by another diagnosis. Objectives: The present study aims to determine the most common symptoms of the long COVID syndrome and their impact on the quality of life.

pmc-11430975.title: Whole Exome Sequencing of Adult Indians with Apparently Acquired Aplastic Anaemia: Initial Experience at Tertiary Care Hospital
pmc-11430975.creator: Sudhir Mehta, Krishna Mohan Medicherla, Sandhya Gulati, Nidhi Sharma, Rabia Parveen, Ashwani Kumar Mishra, Sonal Gupta, Prashanth Suravajhala
pmc-11430975.description: Aplastic anaemia (AA) is a rare hypocellular bone marrow disease with a large number of mutations in the telomerase reverse transcriptase gene (TERT), leading to bone marrow failure. We used our benchmarked whole exome sequencing (WES) pipeline to identify variants in adult Indian subjects with apparently acquired AA.

pmc-11477989.title: Comparative Analysis of Heart Rate Variability and Arterial Stiffness in Elite Male Athletes after COVID-19
pmc-11477989.creator: Mohamed M. Ammar, Noureddine M. Ben Said, Younes N. Ben Said, Ahmed M. Abdelsalam, Sergey P. Levushkin, Aleksey Laptev, Mokhtar Inoubli, Mehdi Chlif
pmc-11477989.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study investigated the long-term cardiovascular effects of coronavirus disease (COVID-19) in elite male athletes by comparing the heart rate variability (HRV), arterial stiffness, and other cardiovascular parameters between those with and without prior COVID-19 infection. Methods: This cross-sectional study evaluated 120 elite male athletes (60 post COVID-19, 60 controls) using anthropometric measurements, body composition analysis, pulmonary function tests, HRV analysis, arterial stiffness assessments, hemodynamic monitoring, and microcirculatory function tests.

pmc-11541060.title: Definite Treatment Delay With Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy and Longitudinal Monitoring by Circulating Tumor DNA for Advanced Cervical Cancer During Pregnancy: A Case Series and Literature Review
pmc-11541060.creator: Xiaoyu Zhang, Hong Yu, Kai Chen, Bo Ding, Yang Shen
pmc-11541060.description: BackgroundPrevious studies mainly concentrate on neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) for delivery delay in FIGO Stage IB1–IIIB cervical cancer during pregnancy to prevent early preterm delivery while not affecting maternal outcome.CaseHere, we described two pregnant patients with FIGO Stage IIIC cervical cancer about their diagnosis, treatment, and outcome.

pmc-12645329.title: Condition-Specific Growth Charts for Children With Alagille Syndrome
pmc-12645329.creator: Koen Huysentruyt, Shannon M. Vandriel, Mathieu Roelants, David A. Piccoli, Kathleen M. Loomes, Elizabeth B. Rand, Noelle H. Ebel, Jeffrey A. Feinstein, Irena Jankowska, Piotr Czubkowski, Dorota Gliwicz-Miedzińska, Emmanuel M. Gonzales, Emmanuel Jacquemin, Jérôme Bouligand, Saul J. Karpen, Rene Romer
pmc-12645329.description: Key PointsQuestionWhat do condition-specific growth charts look like for children with Alagille syndrome (ALGS)?FindingsIn this case series of 1204 children with ALGS, growth charts developed for boys and girls using modern statistical techniques based on 9855 weight and 8463 height observations showed markedly different growth patterns when overlaid with US growth charts for children with typical development.

pmc-12788071.title: Microplastic Pollution in the Environment: A Chemical Engineering Perspective on Sources, Fate, and Mitigation Strategies
pmc-12788071.creator: Mahmoud Allawy Mohsin, Ahmed Hayder Abd zaid
pmc-12788071.description: Microplastic pollution is a defining environmental crisis of the Anthropocene, threatening ecosystems and human health due to its persistence and global dispersion. This review synthesizes current knowledge through a chemical engineering framework, analyzing the contaminant’s lifecycle from formation and environmental fate to detection and removal. We systematically evaluate conventional and advanced mitigation technologies, highlighting the potential of engineered adsorbents (e.g.

pmc-13113582.title: HSP90AA1 Facilitates Vascular Calcification in Chronic Kidney Disease Involving Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy
pmc-13113582.creator: Yaling Zhang, Ming Li, Yanwen Luo, Liming Huang, Sipei Chen, Guisen Li, Yi Li, Li Wang
pmc-13113582.description: Background: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) associated vascular calcification (VC) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, partially driven by osteogenic transdifferentiation of vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs). Chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA) is a selective lysosomal degradation cellular process. However, the precise role and mechanism of CMA in CKD-associated vascular calcification remain unknown.

pmc-13144807.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2144 MATRIX METALLOPROTEINASE-9 AS A PROGNOSTIC BIOMARKER IN ACUTE INTRACEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE
pmc-13144807.creator: Sardor Musayev, Gulnora Rakhimbaeva, Yulduz Musaeva, Tolibjon Khomidov
pmc-13144807.description: Background and aimsAcute intracerebral hemorrhage is associated with high mortality and severe neurological deficits. Matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) plays a critical role in blood–brain barrier disruption, hematoma expansion, and secondary brain injury. Identifying reliable biochemical biomarkers linked to clinical severity may improve early prognosis and individualized management in hemorrhagic stroke.

pmc-13207146.title: Ergosterol: Biological Activities, Mechanistic Evidence, Pharmacokinetic Barriers, and Delivery Strategies
pmc-13207146.creator: Mingkai Yao, Cui Li, Mengya Dang, Na Zhang, Xiaoyun Yang, Yuping Wang, Mengru Cai, Dong Bai
pmc-13207146.description: Ergosterol is a fungal sterol with broad pharmacological activities, including anticancer, anti-inflammatory, cholesterol- and uric acid-lowering effects, and serves as the precursor of vitamin D2. Despite its therapeutic potential, poor aqueous solubility, physicochemical instability, and low oral bioavailability severely limit its clinical application.

pmc-13360876.title: Factors associated with HIV infection among infants born to mothers with HIV in Blantyre, Malawi: a mixed methods study
pmc-13360876.creator: Agness Wallace Tsegula, Victor Mwapasa
pmc-13360876.description: BackgroundHIV infection is a major cause of mortality and morbidity among infants in Malawi. Despite the scale-up of elimination of mother-to-child transmission (e-MTCT) services in Malawi, the mother-to-child transmission rate was 6.5% in 2021. Therefore, the study aimed to assess factors that are associated with HIV infection among infants born to mothers with HIV in Blantyre, Malawi.

pmc-13675598.title: Hepatitis A Virus (HAV) Recurrence and De Novo Hepatitis A Acquired at Time of Liver Transplantation: Comparison of Graft HAV Infection and Viral Kinetics
pmc-13675598.creator: David Mutimer, Elinor Latham, Sowsan F. Atabani, Samreen Ijaz
pmc-13675598.description: Hepatitis A virus (HAV) infection is an uncommon indication for liver transplantation, and donor‐derived or transfusion‐associated HAV infection is rare. Data describing HAV recurrence or early acquisition following liver transplantation, particularly with longitudinal quantitative viral kinetics, are limited. We describe two liver transplant recipients with graft HAV infection occurring in different immunological contexts.
